# intel-ax210-bluetooth

> Intel AX210 Bluetooth — the Bluetooth half of the field laptop's Wi-Fi 6E card, on USB

**Vendor:** Intel  ·  **class:** [bluetooth-controller](bluetooth-controller-class.md)

Status: **untested** — catalogued from documented sources, not yet proven here.

**Not maintainer-verified**: nobody on this project has run this hardware yet. The two facts are recorded separately on purpose (D-027) — a correct recipe and a tested device are different claims.

## What it is

The Bluetooth controller of an Intel AX210 Wi-Fi 6E card, which presents to the kernel as a USB device on the machine's internal bus even though the card sits in an M.2 slot. btusb drives it, BlueZ manages it.

## What you can do with it

Park it for power and radio silence in the field, wake it when a headset or a keyboard is wanted, or switch the radio off through BlueZ without detaching it. See the `bluetooth-controller` class for what each does.

## Setup

Nothing to install. `hammunition hardware park bluetooth-controller` and `hammunition hardware wake bluetooth-controller`; `bluetoothctl power off` is the lighter switch. Parking has not been run on this controller.

## Known problems

A Bluetooth keyboard or mouse goes with a parked controller. Whether the adapter returns powered on after a wake is unmeasured here.
